plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's drive. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
You can help each other get unstuck. When one of you has an idea, the other is often willing to run with it. When something needs to get done, it may feel easier to take the first step together than it would on your own.

This is the kind of connection that can turn good intentions into action. You may encourage each other to send the message, make the plan, start the project, or finally deal with something that has been hanging over your head. The support is there, but it tends to show up through action rather than long conversations about what might happen someday.

Because this energy is easygoing, it can be easy to overlook. You may not always notice how much you motivate each other until you compare it to relationships where nothing ever seems to move forward.

The key is not to overthink it. Make the plan, send the text, take the first step. This connection tends to work best when the two of you are actually doing things together instead of just talking about them.
